messages:
alex_chen: quick sync — spun up a 4xA10 pool to try speculative decode on llama4t-mini quant8. goal: 2x tail throughput w/ <=1% quality drop on HELPER-v2.
tara_m: nice. what's the decoding setup? greedy spec or sampling-based? any safety fallback?
alex_chen: hybrid: greedy main + speculative beam of width=2 with early-accept heuristics. fallback to greedy on low-confidence (entropy > 4.5). we also enable kv-prefix caching at worker level.
jamal: can you paste the launch command? want to reproduce CPU/GPU pinning.
alex_chen: sure — run was: ```
redwood run --model=llama4t-mini.quant8 --spec_decode=on
  --spec_width=2 --entropy_gate=4.5
  --kv_cache=shared --batcher=continuous --replicas=4
```
benchbot: quick results (50k requests synthetic): median latency 48ms -> 36ms, p95 210ms -> 130ms, throughput +1.9x. quality delta (HELPER-v2) exact-match: -0.8%, nlg-bleu: -0.6%.
tara_m: wow p95 drop is solid. 0.8% EM hit borderline but maybe acceptable depending on route. did you run on any safety prompts or high-regret cases?
alex_chen: ran 2k safety holdouts — speculative triggered in 62% of tokens. safety-scored outputs had minimal divergence; no additional toxic flags triggered. but there were a few weird truncations on long-form answers (3 cases) where beam accepted too early.
jamal: can we tighten early-accept? maybe use KL against greedy baseline or increase entropy_gate to 5.0 and re-run small sweep.
alex_chen: ack. next sweep planned: entropy_gate=5.0, spec_width=1 (cheap) and KL-penalty=0.2 fallback. Also try disabled prefix-cache variant to see interaction.
benchbot: adding those to queue. estimated run-time ~ 3h for 100k sample set.
sre-bot: FYI deployed canary rule to protect production routes: any spec decode with EM delta > 1.5% auto-rolls to greedy.
tara_m: good. also let's capture per-route token-cost change and A/B against current hosted config. i'll own the cost table.
alex_chen: thanks. action items: 1) jamal to run small sweep with entropy=5.0 + KL fallback (today). 2) benchbot to run macro eval (tonight). 3) tara to compute cost delta and risk threshold. 4) i'll do post-mortem on the 3 truncation cases and add a unit test to the decode harness.
jamal: on it. i'll post logs/results here when done. short term, recommend enabling spec decode on non-critical background routes only.
alex_chen: agreed. final ask: anyone seen unexpected perf regressions on quant8 for llama4t-mini in other experiments? i recall a subtle kv-eviction bug in last month's run.
tara_m: saw a one-off spike when batcher hit ephemeral memory pressure, but that was with older batcher flags. new continuous batcher looked stable.
jamal: same — no regressions in latest AMI.
alex_chen: ok closing for now. will post updated metrics + the small-sweep results in the morning. :thumbsup:
